title: zostera minor
intro: Zostera minor, commonly known as dwarf eelgrass, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Zosteraceae. The health benefits of Zostera minor include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health, making it a valuable component in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Zostera minor are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Zostera minor are thought to contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including its ability to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
